text:
[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part IX · Suits Relating to Miscellaneous Matters
 Section: 99::One year.
]


To set aside a sale by a civil or revenue court or a sale for arrears of Government revenue or for any demand recoverable as such arrears.
Period of limitationOne year.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the sale is confirmed or would otherwise have become final and conclusive had no such suit been brought.
